title: Onboarding drained queue completion ignores injection done flag
summary: A drained onboarding queue can report route-level done:false when autoInject is true and injection metadata is stuck, even with total processed, remaining 0, inflight 0, kept notes, and injectedKept 0. The dashboard must treat counter-drained learning (total > 0, no error, remaining 0, inflight 0, processed/visualProcessed >= total) as UI-complete so the normal dashboard opens instead of waiting forever on injection completion metadata.
